meta.title: RFQ: revoke is not possible after the event closed

plan.title: SRC-RVK-003 — Revoke unavailable after RFQ closes

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary specified by the setup.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared closed RFQ in Vendor A's vendor event list and enter its pricing round.
Assert that the vendor portal does not offer a Revoke control after bidding has ended.
Confirm Vendor A's existing bid remains submitted.
